Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That's all we have from this lopsided affair. This also concludes the T20I series. We now move into the second leg of this series, which is the one-off ODI between New Zealand and Scotland. That game will be played on Sunday 31st of July. The action is all set to begin at 3.30 pm IST (10.00 am GMT). Do not forget to join us in advance for the build-up. For now, you can switch tabs and enjoy the action from the game between West Indies and India and Barbados Women versus Pakistan Women. It's goodbye from here!

Mitchell Santner the skipper of New Zealand says that they started off well with the bat and to put up this kind of total was special. Credits the batters for going on the attack straight away. Says he is happy with his team and is glad that different guys have stepped up at different times. Says that they needed to keep the momentum going in the innings. Mentions Mark Chapman as a quality player and says it is good to see the players taking the opportunity when they get a chance to play. Says he is looking forward to the ODI game and says it’s a different kind of game. Mentions that they need to see who to play for that game and says the boys are eager to be a part of it.

Richie Berrington the skipper of Scotland says that it was disappointing today, they knew it was a batting surface, but they missed an opportunity and they cannot afford to miss out on these chances at this stage. Adds that they never had an opportunity to put New Zealand under pressure and he credits them for the way they batted. Further adds that there is no room for error on this batting track. He concludes by saying that they will go back and reflect on their performance and come back stronger in the ODI.

Mark Chapman is the Player of the Match. He says that he was happy to be out there and to contribute. Mentions that he is happy to get an opportunity and score some runs. Adds that they had a plan of hitting the gaps and it went well. Concludes by saying that they spoke about having the right mindset about taking the game on.
Time for the presentation...

Earlier in the game, the New Zealand batters were in devastating form and they began attacking right from the first over. This reached a total of 254 courtesy half-centuries from Mark Chapman and Michael Bracewell. There were short cameos from Daryl Mitchell, Dane Cleaver, and James Neesham that contributed to the massive score. Scotland bowlers failed to find the right line and length and were plundered all over the field. Chris Greaves was once again the only player who seemed like he could bowl with any sort of control.

New Zealand have had a pretty easy outing and looked completely in control right from the word go. Seven bowlers were used and six of them had at least a wicket under their belt. This has been a great opportunity for the Kiwis to understand their squad strength building up to the T20 World Cup. If there is anything they need to rectify in this almost flawless performance, is the fact that they should have been able to take all ten wickets. They would have been hoping for a better challenge as the game was already pretty much won by the batters.

Scotland were never really in this game chasing a mammoth target and fell even more behind when they lost their top order in no time. They were reduced to 37 for the loss of four wickets and when skipper Richie Berrington departed next with the team total on 67, the crowd was seen exiting the stadium. Chris Greaves played a cameo and has looked by far the best player on the team. He along with the tail managed to push the total beyond the 150 mark but were well short.

The brings an end to a pretty one-sided affair. Scotland have been unable to put up a fight in either of the games and have lost the series 2-0 to the visitors. New Zealand seal an easy win by a margin in excess of 100. Despite resting their big guns, the visitors have cruised through this T20I series.
A single to end the match! Back of a length, around middle. Hamza Tahir miscues his pull shot towards mid on for a run. New Zealand win by 102 runs and seal the series 2-0!
Fuller ball, around off. Gavin Main slices this one towards deep cover. Another single taken.
Overpitched delivery, around off. Gavin Main makes room and drives it towards Mitchell Santner at mid off.
Full again, around middle. Hamza Tahir drives it down to long on. 150 up for Scotland!
Swing and a miss! Wide of off, shorter ball. Hamza Tahir looks to slash this one away but he misses.
Pitches it up, and outside off. Hamza Tahir pushes this one towards mid off.
Back of a length, around off. Gavin Main blocks it out towards the off side.
Fuller one, around off. Gavin Main drives it towards mid off.
Another off-pace delivery, full and outside off. Gavin Main this time goes for a scoop but he fails to get any bat on it again.
Slower one, on a length, around off. Gavin Main looks to reverse-scoop this one but he misses.
Back of a length, outside off. Hamza Tahir pushes it off the back foot towards deep cover for a single.
Shorter one, outside off. Gavin Main pushes it back to the bowler.
Tosses it up, full, and on middle. Hamza Tahir blocks it out.
Hamza Tahir is the last batter to make his way out to the crease.

OUT! TAKEN! Two wickets in two overs for Michael Rippon! He sends back Alasdair Evans now. A fuller ball, tosses it up, on middle. Alasdair Evans gets down on his knee and reverse-sweeps it straight to the man at backward point. Jacob Duffy takes an easy there.
Commentary.Howout: c Jacob Duffy b Michael Rippon

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller one, around off, spinning away. Alasdair Evans looks to sweep this away but he misses. The ball goes off pads towards point.
Quicker, shorter and outside off. Alasdair Evans cuts it towards short third man for a couple of runs.
Tosses it up again, full and on middle. Alasdair Evans gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a brace.
Wide! Shorter one, wide of off. Alasdair Evans looks to reverse-pull this one but he misss. Wide called!
FOUR! Consecutive fours for Scotland! A loopy ball, full, around middle and off. Alasdair Evans sweeps it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over! Shorter one, wide of off. Gavin Main slaps it through cover for a cracking boundary.
Slower shorter ball, around off. Gavin Main looks to pull this one but he misses.
FOUR! Cheeky shot! A low full toss, down the leg side. Gavin Main moves across and scoops it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Alasdair Evans comes out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Ben Sears strikes and he grabs his first wicket of the game! A fullish ball, around middle and off. Mark Watt heaves this across the line and towards wide long on. He does not time it as well, and the ball goes into the hand of James Neesham who ran towards his left for the catch. New Zealand are two wickets away now.
Commentary.Howout: c James Neesham b Ben Sears

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, around off. Gavin Main drives it towards mid off for a quick single.
Back of a length, around middle and off. Mark Watt dabs it towards point and takes a single.
Beaten! Lovey ball! Fullish, outside off, spinning away from the right-hander. Gavin Main looks to push this away but he gets beaten.
Outside off, shorter one. Mark Watt cuts it towards point for a single.

FOUR! Up and over! A loopy ball, spinning away from the left-hander, outside off. Mark Watt advances down the pitch and lifts it towards long off. Mark Chapman there gets his hands to the ball but he fails to grab it. The ball goes over the ropes for a boundary.
Tosses this one up, full, around middle. Gavin Main sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
An appeal for LBW, but turned down! This one spins in, around middle, shorter ball. Gavin Main looks to flick this but he misses. That was probably too high!
Gavin Main walks out to the middle.

OUT! STUMPED! Michael Rippon gets a wicket on his T20I debut! Lovely delivery! The googly has done the trick for him! Shorter one, spinning away, wide of off. Michael Leask dances down the pitch and looks to go over cover but he fails to reach the ball. Dane Cleaver collects the ball and whips the bails off. Scotland have lost their seventh wicket.
Commentary.Howout: st Dane Cleaver b Michael Rippon

Commentary.Commentary: Jacob Duffy goes full on the pads, Michael Bracewell makes room to slap this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! This has been hit well and finds the gap in the deep! Jacob Duffy bangs this in short and it sits up nicely for Michael Leask to pull this in the gap between deep square leg and deep mid-wicket for a boundary!
This is a fraction short and outside off, Mark Watt slaps the ball across towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Jacob Duffy bowls this on a good length and on leg, Mark Watt works this through mid-wicket and runs well to get a couple of runs.
Slower delivery angled into the stumps, Michael Leask heaves this towards mid-wicket for a single.
Jacob Duffy serves a slower delivery on a good length and outside off, Michael Leask fends this back to the bowler.
This is a fraction and angled into the batter. Mark Watt fends this towards cover.

What sensational fielding from Daryl Mitchell on the boundary! Saves five runs for his team! Michael Rippon flights this full outside off, Michael Leask lifts this towards long on where Daryl Mitchell pulls off the blinder to keep the ball from going over the boundary! Just one run!
Tighter line from Michael Rippon as he serves this short. Mark Watt taps this towards deep point for a single.
Goes short and wide outside off, Mark Watt lifts this over cover for a couple of runs.
This is full and outside off, Mark Watt defends this back to the bowler who dives to his right to stop the ball.
Michael Rippon serves this short and in line with the stumps, Michael Leask goes back in the crease and lifts it towards long on for a single.
Ish Sodhi bowls this short and outside off, Michael Leask drags the ball from way outside off towards long on for a single to keep strike. Three runs and a wicket from this over!
Ish Sodhi goes full on the pads, Mark Watt flicks this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Mark Watt makes his way to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! A stunning catch from Ish Sodhi to dismiss the well-set, Chris Greaves! That was an absolute blinder! A loopy ball, leg-break, outside off. Chris Greaves advances down the pitch and hits it uppishly towards the right of the bowler. Ish Sodhi sticks his right hand out and takes a terrific one-handed catch. Scotland are now 6 down!
A googly now, full, down the leg side. Chris Greaves looks to sweep this one but he misses and gets hit on his pads. An appeal there for LBW, but the umpire says no! That was sliding down leg.
Tosses this one up. Michael Leask sweeps this one from outside off towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball, around middle and off. Michael Leask plays it back to the bowler.
This is flighted full outside off, Chris Greaves goes for the heave and misses. Another tight over from New Zealand!
This is full and outside off, Michael Leask sweeps the ball towards backward square leg for a single.
This is short and slow, Michael Leask looks to pull and misses out on this loose delivery.

In the air... and dropped! Mitchell Santner flights this full and angles this into the batter. Chris Greaves goes for the reverse sweep and top edges it towards short third man. Jacob Duffy gets under this but makes an absolute mess of it. Chris Greaves gets a life!
This one is short as well and wide outside off, Chris Greaves finds the gap past cover for a couple of runs.
Mitchell Santner begins with a slow delivery short and outside off. Chris Greaves finds the cover fielder.
Short and wide once again. Chris Greaves plays this to deep cover for a single. Just four runs of the over.
Bowls this wide outside off and full Michael Leask reaches for it and drags this towards long on for a single.
This is a leg spinner that pitches outside off and goes further away. Michael Leask swings and misses.
This is really wide outside off and would have been wide. Michael Leask reaches for it and bottom edges it into the ground.
Ish Sodhi lofts this really full outside off, Chris Greaves reaches for it and hits a full toss to long off for a run.
Goes short and outside off, Michael Leask works this down to long off for a single.
WIDE! Ish Sodhi serves a flighted delivery full and really wide outside off. The umpire calls this wide.
Spinning in, full, around off. Chris Greaves leans to block this one but he misses and gets hit on his pads. 17 runs off Michael Rippon's first over in T20I cricket!
SIX! Chris Greaves with yet another sweep! Wonderful shot once again. A tossed-up delivery, full, around off. Chris Greaves slog-sweeps this over deep square leg for another maximum in the over.
A fuller one, loopy ball, around off. Chris Greaves looks to sweep but he changes his mind in the end and blocks it out.
Wide! Big turn there for Michael Rippon! Shorter one, it pitches around middle and spins down the leg side. Wide called!

FOUR! Another sweep and another boundary for Chris Greaves! A loopy ball again, full in length, around the leg pole. Chris Greaves sweeps this but the ball goes off the top edge towards fine leg. It goes one bounce over the ropes for a boundary.
We have a slight halt in play as the ball seems to be chipped. Hit the scaffolding beyond the boundary and the ball needs to be changed.

SIX! Another maximum from Chris Greaves! Michael Rippon tosses this one up, serves a fuller ball, around off. Chris Greaves gets down on his knee and slog-sweeps this over deep square leg for a biggie.
Loopy ball, full and around the leg pole. Chris Greaves looks to clip this away but he misses and gets hit on his pads.
Swing and a miss! Shorter one, outside off. Michael Leask looks to cut this away but he misses.
Shorter one this time, spinning away, outside off. Chris Greaves stays in his crease and knocks it through cover. Only a single.
SIX! Up and away! Top shot! Fuller one, around middle and off. Chris Greaves gets down on his knee and sweeps it high over deep square leg for a biggie!
Tosses it this one up, around off. Chris Greaves makes room and pushes it over cover. Two taken!
Shorter one this time, outside off. Michael Leask cuts it towards point. Single taken! There is a throw at the keeper's end but the batter seems to have made his ground.
Full and on middle. Chris Greaves sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
Beaten! Lovely ball! Shorter one, spinning away, outside off. Michael Leask makes room and looks to push this away but he misses as the ball spins away sharply.
Tosses it up again, full, down the leg side. Michael Leask flicks it towards square leg.
Loopy ball, pitches it up, around middle. Chris Greaves steps down the ground and knocks it to long on for a single.
Quicker, fuller, around middle. Chris Greaves looks to sweep this one but he misses.
Michael Leask comes to the crease.

OUT! TAKEN! Mitchell Santner strikes and gets rid of the Scotland skipper. The home side has not lost half their side now. A fuller one, around middle and off. Richie Berrington makes room, and lifts it wide of long off. Daryl Mitchell runs to his left and takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Daryl Mitchell b Mitchell Santner

Commentary.Commentary: Turning in, around middle and leg. Chris Greaves tucks it towards square leg and takes a single.
SIX! Top shot! Loopy ball, full, and outside off. Richie Berrington smashes it with a flat-bat over the bowlers head for a biggie!
On the pads, fuller one, loopy ball. Chris Greaves sweeps it towards short fine leg for a single.
Tosses it up, shorter one, outside off. Richie Berrington cuts it towards point. Single taken!
Full again, outside off, tosses it up. Chris Greaves taps it towards cover for a single.
Tosses it up, full, around off. Richie Berrington pushes it towards mid off and takes a single.

Two leg byes! Ish Sodhi begins with a googly, a fuller one, around middle and off. Richie Berrington looks to work it away on the leg side but he misses. The ball rolls away towards short third man off his pads. The batters steal in a leg bye! There is a throw at the bowler's end as well, but its well away. Another run taken!
Bowls this short and outside off, Chris Greaves goes back and slashes the ball straight to point. 13 runs of the over and Scotland end the powerplay on 54/4. New Zealand are well and truly on top!
Mitchell Santner fires this full into the pads, Richie Berrington looks to heave and gets an inside edge onto his pads. Takes a single as the ball rolls over to the leg side.

FOUR! Richie Berrington is taking the attack to Mitchell Santner! this is flighted full and angling into the batter, Richie Berrington gets down the wicket and lofts this towards deep square leg for four more runs!
FOUR! Inside edge for a boundary! Mitchell Santner fires this one in full and into the pads, Richie Berrington charges down the wicket and swings, gets an inside edge down to fine leg for a boundary!
This is full and in line with the stumps, Richie Berrington fends this back to the bowler.
FOUR! This runs away fine! Mitchell Santner serves this full and angling into the stumps, Richie Berrington opens the face of the bat and runs it down to fine thrid man for a boundary!
Ben Sears goes full and just outside off, Chris Greaves fends this solidly back towards the bowler.
Ben Sears serves a short delivery outside off, Chris Greaves looks to pull and misses and he is beaten by the slower delivery.
A length delivery, darting it on the pads. Chris Greaves flicks it towards square leg for a brace.
Back of a length, around off. Chris Greaves pushes it back to the bowler.
Two leg byes! On a length, and on the thigh pad. Chris Greaves looks to flick this one but he misses. The ball brushes off his thigh pad and goes towards fine leg. Two taken!

OUT! RUN OUT! Oh, dear! Scotland are falling apart here! Another one bites the dust! A length ball, outside off. Richie Berrington stays in his crease and looks to cut this away, But the ball goes off the under edge and the batters scamper across for a quick singe. The ball goes towards the right of the keeper, Dane Cleaver runs forward to his right, collects the ball, and throws it directly at the stumps at the striker's end. Oliver Hairs is nowhere near the crease. He walks back to the hut.

FOUR! Oliver Hairs gets off the mark with a boundary! James Neesham goes full outside off, Oliver Hairs swings and gets a thick outside edge towards third man for another boundary! 2 wickets and 2 boundaries in this over!

OUT! CAUGHT! Matthew Cross has given away his wicket here! James Neesham gets a wicket with a nothing ball! James Neesham bangs this in short and wide outside off, Matthew Cross just lifts this towards point into the hand of Michael Bracewell who takes an easy catch. Matthew Cross seemed to have been deceived by the pace here! Scotland in deep trouble!
Commentary.Howout: c Michael Bracewell b James Neesham

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Matthew Cross has decided to play on the offense! James Neesham serves this back of a length and angled into the batter. Matthew Cross slaps this wide off long on for a boundary!
James Neesham serves this full outside off, Richie Berrington plays this to deep cover for a isngle.
Richie Berrington, the skipper of Scotland makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! LBW! PLUMB! James Neesham serves a full delivery angled into the stumps, George Munsey looks to work this leg side but he misses and gets hit on his pad. James Neesham does not even look back at the umpire as he runs off in celebration! The umpire does raise his finger and the dangerous man, George Munsey departs! New Zealand have their second wicket!
James Neesham begins with a good length delivery angling into the left-hander from 'round the wicket. George Munsey fends this towards cover.
FOUR! Matthew Cross makes use of the poor delivery! Ben Sears bowls this on the pads on a fuller length. Matthew Cross lifts the ball over short fine leg for a boundary to deep backward square leg.
This is short and angling into the batter. Matthew Cross mistimes his pull towards square leg.
WIDE! Strays down leg from a fuller length. Matthew Cross looks to heave the leg side and its quite far away. called wide by the umpire.

FOUR! Matthew Cross gets a hold of this one! Ben Sears bowls this full and angling into the stumps, Matthew Cross just lifts this over the bowler towards the long fence for a boundary! That could break the shackles.
Ben Sears goes full and angles this down leg, Matthew Cross looks to guide it down leg and gets a bit of pad as it goes through to the keeper.
This is on a good length as well and closer to the stumps, George Munsey guides this towards backward point for a single.
Ben Sears begins with a good length delivery outside off, George Munsey knocks this straight to point.
Matthew Cross walks out to bat. Also, Ben Sears comes into the attack.

OUT! CAUGHT! Michael Jones short innings has come to an end! Michael Bracewell slights this full outside off, Michael Jones gets down the wicket and smashes this deep square leg. Does not time this well and finds Daryl Mitchell who takes an easy catch! Scotland lose their first wicket!
Commentary.Howout: c Daryl Mitchell b Michael Bracewell

Commentary.Commentary: This is short and spinning into the batter. Michael Jones nudges it towards mid-wicket!
Michael Bracewell bowls this short and outside off, George Munsey works this towards backward point for a single.
Another shorter one, turning away, around off. George Munsey knocks it towards point off the back foot.
Shorter one this time, around off. George Munsey makes room and pushes it towards cover-point.
FOUR! George Munsey takes on Michael Bracewell straightaway! A fuller one, tosses it up, around off. George Munsey makes room and smashes this one over mid off for a boundary!
Who will bowl from the other end? Michael Bracewell it is!
Jacob Duffy goes short and follows the batter as he looks to make room. George Munsey pulls this towards fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Three boundaries of the over! Jacob Duffy goes full and outside off, George Munsey times this between point and cover for a beautiful boundary! Good start for Scotland!
FOUR! This is a short arm jab! Jacob Duffy bangs this in short in line with the stumps and sits up nicely for George Munsey to pull this towards the deep square leg boundary for a boundary!
This is full and on leg, George Munsey digs the ball out towards mid on.
FOUR! Scotland are on their way! Jacob Duffy Bowls this short and outside off, George Munsey slashes hard at this as the ball flies to the deep backward point for a boundary!
Jacob Duffy serves this on a length and pitching outside leg, George Munsey gets cramped for room as he looks to play this leg side.
